definitions.short: Elijah , the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites
definitions.full: H452. Eliyyah אֵלִיָּה 2Kin 1:3-4 t.; אֵלִיָּ֫הוּ 1Kin 17:1 62t.; proper name, masculine ( Yah(u) is God , compare יוֺאֵל ) a. Elijah, the great prophet of the reign of Ahab 1Kin 17:1 65t. Kings; 2Chr 21:12 ; Malachi 3:23. b. Benjamite 1Chr 8:27 ; c. a priest of Ezra's time Ezra 10:21 ; d. a son of Elam Ezra 10:26 .
